about: Power tree from the batteries to the loads, as far as the board designs show. Each node has the board it lives on; edges carry the net name from the design. "confidence" is confirmed (seen in a schematic/netlist or code) or inferred.

nodes.label: Port battery
nodes.detail: 5 Li-ion cells in series (BQ40Z80 config), 45 A protector fuse

nodes.label: Starboard battery
nodes.detail: same housing design as port

nodes.label: Ideal-diode OR
nodes.detail: 2 x LTC4412 + 4 x SiR167DP. Whichever battery is higher supplies V+; STAT pins report which are supplying.

nodes.label: V+ battery bus
nodes.detail: Diagnostics warn below 18.5 V (battery_volt.warn) and list 17 V as thruster_cutoff.

nodes.label: Kill switch
nodes.detail: 3 x SiR167DP high-side P-FETs with TC4432 gate drivers. Needs the physical switch AND the RP2040 SOFTWARE_KILL line to allow power.

nodes.label: ESC board 0
nodes.detail: reverse protection, 60 A fuse, 4 x 15 A fuses, 4 ESCs

nodes.label: 8 thrusters
nodes.detail: 4 per ESC board

nodes.label: Vreg
nodes.detail: MBRB2545CT Schottky from V+; measured as "balanced_voltage" (diagnostics expect 18.5-21.5 V)

nodes.label: 15 V rail
nodes.detail: PS1 TDK-Lambda i6A4W (20 A module). Reported as "twelve_volt_voltage"; diagnostics expect 14.7-16.0 V.

nodes.label: 5 V rail
nodes.detail: PS2 TDK-Lambda i6A4W (20 A module); diagnostics expect 4.7-5.7 V

nodes.label: 12 V (servo)
nodes.detail: MIC29300-12 LDO from 15 V; only goes to LID_CONN1. Not measured by the ADC.

nodes.label: 3.3 V (each board)
nodes.detail: LM1117-3.3 from 5 V on every RP2040 board; the POAC reports its own (3.2-3.4 V expected)

nodes.label: Torpedo/marker servo
nodes.detail: Hiwonder bus servo on the lid connector

nodes.label: Board-stack fan
nodes.detail: 5 V, switched

nodes.label: Stack link
nodes.detail: Mini-Fit Jr: CAN + V+ + 5V + 15V

nodes.label: LED board
nodes.detail: LED drivers run from V+, logic from 5 V

nodes.label: IVC board
nodes.detail: V+ (1.5 A fuse) -> isolated +/-24 V for the transducer amp; 5 V -> +/-5 V for receive

nodes.label: Camera cage breakout
nodes.detail: gets 15 V and 5 V from the POAC "CAMERA CAGE" connector

nodes.label: Jetson AGX Orin
nodes.detail: 15 V through FDD4141 switch (ORIN_SW, on at boot)

nodes.label: DVL
nodes.detail: 15 V injected on pins 7-8 of its Ethernet cable: CCBB J14 (silk "DVL SUBCONN") carries 15V + GND there; J13 (silk "DVL | SWITCH") passes the data pairs on to the network switch
nodes.confidence: confirmed (netlist + silk); the DVL's own supply range is not in the designs

nodes.label: Network switch
nodes.detail: 5 V on J16 (schematic "Network Switch Power", silk "SWITCH")
nodes.confidence: confirmed (connector); switch model not in the designs

nodes.label: Peltier cooler
nodes.detail: 15 V switched (PELT_SW)
nodes.confidence: inferred (only the connector and switch are confirmed; whether a Peltier is fitted today is unconfirmed)

nodes.label: Cage fans (up to 4)
nodes.detail: 5 V switched, tach inputs

nodes.label: Depth sensor
nodes.detail: 5 V + I2C (MS5837-02BA, i.e. Bar02)

nodes.label: RGB status strip
nodes.detail: 5 V

nodes.label: External CAN devices
nodes.detail: 15 V + external CAN on J1/J5
nodes.confidence: confirmed (connector); what is plugged in today is unconfirmed

edges.confidence: inferred (ESC J6 carries 5V; the cable to the POAC is not in the designs)

fields.measures: LTC4412 STAT: is this battery supplying V+
